name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de South Miami

title.en: Approved on first reading a franchise and two ground leases with 13th Floor Link at SoMi, LLC for the City Hall redevelopment
title.es: Aprobó en primera lectura una franquicia y dos arrendamientos de terreno con 13th Floor Link at SoMi, LLC para la reurbanización del Ayuntamiento
title.ht: Apwouve nan premye lekti yon franchiz ak de kontra lokasyon tè ak 13th Floor Link at SoMi, LLC pou rebati Meri a

Calle.en: The donor 13th Floor Fund V, LP shares the 13th Floor name with the developer; Arnaud Karsenti is a 13th Floor founder. The gifts came about a week after the term sheet vote.
Calle.es: El donante 13th Floor Fund V, LP comparte el nombre 13th Floor con el desarrollador; Arnaud Karsenti es fundador de 13th Floor. Los aportes llegaron una semana después del voto sobre la hoja de términos.
Calle.ht: Donatè 13th Floor Fund V, LP pote menm non 13th Floor ak pwomotè a; Arnaud Karsenti se youn nan fondatè 13th Floor. Don yo rive anviwon yon semèn apre vòt sou dokiman kondisyon an.
